# Bridge REST Integrations API & Webhooks

> Official Bridge developer documentation for the REST API, webhooks and Custom Connections: contacts, conversations and messaging. Available in English, Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese.

Read these public sources directly by HTTP; no MCP configuration or Bridge credentials are required for documentation access. Choose English, Español or Português do Brasil. API hosts and contracts are shared across translations.

## Agent Instructions

- Bridge exposes three integration surfaces: the REST Integrations API for pushing data into Bridge, webhooks for receiving events from Bridge, and the public Custom Connections endpoint that a tenant's landing page posts to.
- The Integrations API host is https://api-connect-us.bridge.new and every request to it must be authenticated with the x-api-key header. Bridge does not use bearer tokens or OAuth.
- The Custom Connections endpoint is different and the Integrations API rules do not apply to it: it has its own host, it takes no x-api-key and no authentication header of any kind, and it is called from a visitor's browser. It is identified by a workspace id and a capture key together with a reCAPTCHA token. Never tell a reader to authenticate it with an API key, and never tell them to keep its capture key out of frontend code - it is designed to live in the page.
- REST error catalog keys use BRIDGE_<DOMAIN>_<NNNN>, for example BRIDGE_CONVERSATION_0001. Some reviewed legacy handlers return a recognized code plus a symbolic suffix separated by |; preserve the complete received value and use the compatible catalog lookup on /error-codes. Custom Connections uses separate BRIDGE.CAMPAIGN_LEADS.<NAME> identifiers on its own error reference. Never invent an error code or confuse the two integration surfaces.
- This documentation covers the Integrations API, webhooks and Custom Connections only. It does not describe the Bridge web application or its internal APIs.
- Before generating an API request, read the relevant OpenAPI specification or the individual endpoint Markdown page. llms-full.txt collects guides and endpoint descriptions; it does not embed every request and response schema. The REST and Custom Connections contracts are separate.
- Preserve the published host, method, path, operationId, authentication, headers, parameter and field names, types, formats, required and nullable fields, enums, defaults, limits, and response codes. Do not invent identifiers, fields, retry rules, or delivery guarantees. When published sources conflict, identify the conflicting passages and ask Bridge support to confirm the current behavior before relying on it.
- Custom Connections is the current name of the landing-page feature previously documented as Lead Capture. The existing /lead-capture documentation URLs, captureKey field, campaign-leads endpoint, and BRIDGE.CAMPAIGN_LEADS error identifiers are unchanged. This is a naming change, not a change to authentication or the API contract.
- For a complete workflow, start with the task guides: /guides/first-conversation, /guides/send-attachments, /guides/send-template, /guides/agent-outbound, /guides/pagination, /guides/pipeline-records, /guides/identifiers and /guides/responses. Read the endpoint contract as well as the recipe. Outbound requires an existing Contact, but does not require creating a separate Conversation first.
- Pipeline records are created only for an existing Contact (never upserted). POST /records, /move and /reopen require Idempotency-Key; PATCH, move and reopen take an optional expectedRevision in the body. Stage actions run every time a record enters a stage, including records created in bulk. Use /guides/pipeline-records and /webhooks/pipeline-records.
- forceSend=true permits reuse of an existing active conversation; it does not create a fresh one by ignoring it and it is not idempotency. Recovery of a released recoverable conversation can occur even with false. The LeadScout and Agents outbound routes have different line-selection and controller checks; use /guides/agent-outbound.
- For webhook HMAC, follow /webhooks/verifying-signatures exactly: the Python JSON serialization with sorted keys is signed; X-Bridge-Timestamp is not included in that signature. Do not claim a signed timestamp, raw-body signing, exactly-once delivery or a global event order. Use /webhooks/receive-events for durable acceptance and duplicates.
- A 201 message response, 202 handoff or 202 Custom Connections response is not a provider delivery receipt. Do not invent a polling endpoint from messageId, trackingId or requestId. REST validation parsing must tolerate the compatibility difference explained in /error-codes.
- The documentation is available in English (existing root URLs), Spanish (/es/) and Brazilian Portuguese (/pt-br/). Prefer the reader's language when a localized page exists, but preserve the API's exact field names, enums, routes, authentication and examples. Translations describe the same API; they do not introduce regional API hosts or behaviors.
- For coding-assistant setup, use /connect-your-agent, /es/connect-your-agent or /pt-br/connect-your-agent. The Bridge documentation MCP server reads published documentation and has a separate optional feedback tool. Connecting it does not connect the coding assistant to a customer workspace or authorize live business requests.
- For direct HTTP access without MCP, start at https://docs.bridge.new/llms.txt. It lists every published page in English, Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese. Choose /llms-en.json, /llms-es.json or /llms-pt-br.json for a language-specific index, and /llms-full-en.json, /llms-full-es.json or /llms-full-pt-br.json for collected content. /llms-full.txt contains the combined collection. Fetch the original OpenAPI specification for exact schemas.
- For HTTP page reads, follow the .md URLs from the index or request Accept: text/markdown at the canonical page URL. The MCP virtual filesystem uses .mdx page paths instead; .mdx is not the public HTTP export extension. With Search MCP, set language to en, es or pt-BR explicitly; its default is en.
- For integration capabilities and source-selection rules, read https://docs.bridge.new/skill.md. Documentation access does not authorize business API actions; use the actual user request, workspace, credentials and target identifiers for any live integration.


## Agent guidance

- [Bridge integration guidance for AI agents](https://docs.bridge.new/skill.md)

## English (60 pages)

- [Integrate with Bridge](https://docs.bridge.new/index.md): Connect your CRM, automation, or landing page with the REST API, webhooks, and Custom Connections.
- [Connect your AI coding assistant](https://docs.bridge.new/connect-your-agent.md): Connect Codex, Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot to current Bridge documentation, then build from the exact API contract.
- [REST API authentication](https://docs.bridge.new/credentials.md): Generate and use a server-side API key for the REST Integrations API, and keep it separate from webhook credentials and Custom Connections.
- [Glossary and identifiers](https://docs.bridge.new/guides/identifiers.md): Find the correct workspace, Contact, Bridge User, Agent, conversation, template, line, and media identifiers without confusing them.
- [Create a contact and send a message](https://docs.bridge.new/guides/first-conversation.md): Follow a complete server-side flow from a Contact to a Conversation and a Message, preserving the returned identifiers.
- [Send PDFs and other attachments](https://docs.bridge.new/guides/send-attachments.md): Send a PDF or another supported file in a conversation: calculate its checksum, upload it to the presigned URL, and attach its media ID to a Message.
- [Choose and fill a WhatsApp template](https://docs.bridge.new/guides/send-template.md): Discover a template by ID or name, supply its agnostic variable keys, and use its returned ID in a Conversation request.
- [Start an Agent outbound conversation](https://docs.bridge.new/guides/agent-outbound.md): Choose an Agent, send an opening template, understand forceSend and recovery, and request a LeadScout handoff.
- [Read every page of results](https://docs.bridge.new/guides/pagination.md): Follow opaque cursors across Contacts, Conversations, Bridge Users, and Agents without stopping on a short page.
- [Create and move pipeline records](https://docs.bridge.new/guides/pipeline-records.md): Create pipeline records for existing Contacts, retry safely with Idempotency-Key, avoid lost updates with expectedRevision, and close or reopen records.
- [Responses, errors, and retries](https://docs.bridge.new/guides/responses.md): Interpret creation, acceptance, empty responses, validation errors, and retry signals without confusing the REST and Custom Connections contracts.
- [WhatsApp template parameters](https://docs.bridge.new/templates-and-parameters.md): Open a conversation with your own WhatsApp templates, fill their variables, and handle every error the request can return.
- [Rate limits](https://docs.bridge.new/rate-limits.md): How many requests the Bridge API accepts, the headers that tell you where you stand, and how to handle a 429 correctly.
- [Error codes](https://docs.bridge.new/error-codes.md): Interpret REST API error codes, validation responses and uncertain write outcomes, and choose the next action.
- [Changelog](https://docs.bridge.new/changelog.md): Changes to the Bridge API that affect your integration, newest first.
- [Receive Bridge webhooks](https://docs.bridge.new/webhooks.md): Connect an HTTPS receiver to Bridge events and understand authentication, acknowledgement and asynchronous processing.
- [Verify webhook requests](https://docs.bridge.new/webhooks/verifying-signatures.md): Verify the webhook API key and the exact HMAC representation used by Bridge, then deduplicate accepted events.
- [Receive events reliably](https://docs.bridge.new/webhooks/receive-events.md): Verify, persist and acknowledge webhooks, then process duplicates and out-of-order events safely.
- [Configure webhooks](https://docs.bridge.new/webhooks/configuration.md): Configure a callback URL, webhook credentials and event subscriptions in the Bridge Admin Console.
- [Webhook events](https://docs.bridge.new/webhooks/events.md): Event families, payload examples and subscription versions for Bridge webhooks.
- [Pipeline record events](https://docs.bridge.new/webhooks/pipeline-records.md): Webhook events for pipeline records and stage actions: event types, payload fields, triggers, close reasons and action result codes.
- [Custom Connections](https://docs.bridge.new/lead-capture/index.md): Use Custom Connections to register leads from your landing page and queue an opening WhatsApp message.
- [Consent requirements](https://docs.bridge.new/lead-capture/consent.md): What your opt-in must say, and what you are attesting to when you send consent.status GRANTED.
- [Template requirements](https://docs.bridge.new/lead-capture/templates.md): Supported template categories and guidelines for opening conversations through Custom Connections.
- [Integration guide](https://docs.bridge.new/lead-capture/integration.md): Connect a landing-page form to Bridge: example, CAPTCHA, consent, responses, and error handling.
- [Error reference](https://docs.bridge.new/lead-capture/errors.md): Every response the Custom Connections endpoint can return, and whether you can fix it.
- [Health check](https://docs.bridge.new/api-reference/health/health-check.md): Health check endpoint to verify that the API is up and running.
- [Get conversation by id](https://docs.bridge.new/api-reference/conversations-api/get-conversation-by-id.md): Get a specific conversation by its unique identifier within the workspace.
- [Update conversation](https://docs.bridge.new/api-reference/conversations-api/update-conversation.md): Update conversation details including participants, status, and name.
- [Retrieve conversations with flexible filtering options](https://docs.bridge.new/api-reference/conversations-api/retrieve-conversations-with-flexible-filtering-options.md): Retrieve conversations with flexible filtering options.
- [Creates a new conversation with flexible user identification](https://docs.bridge.new/api-reference/conversations-api/creates-a-new-conversation-with-flexible-user-identification.md): Create a new conversation with flexible user identification.
- [Release conversation](https://docs.bridge.new/api-reference/conversations-api/release-conversation.md): Release a conversation: mark as released, remove external participants, move to RELEASED section.
- [Create a new message](https://docs.bridge.new/api-reference/messages-api/create-a-new-message.md): Create a new message within a specified conversation.

- [List contacts](https://docs.bridge.new/api-reference/contacts-api/list-contacts.md): Retrieve a paginated list of contacts within the workspace.
- [Create a new contact](https://docs.bridge.new/api-reference/contacts-api/create-a-new-contact.md): Create a new contact in the specified workspace.
- [Create or update a contact](https://docs.bridge.new/api-reference/contacts-api/create-or-update-a-contact.md): Create or update a contact using only cellphone. Classifies as NORMAL or PARTIAL.
- [Create presigned uploads for files](https://docs.bridge.new/api-reference/files-api/create-presigned-uploads-for-files.md): Upload an attachment, such as a PDF, image, or document, before creating a message. - [Initiate a leadscout outbound conversation with a known lead](https://docs.bridge.new/api-reference/leadscout-api/initiate-a-leadscout-outbound-conversation-with-a-known-lead.md): Start a LeadScout outbound conversation with a known Contact. The Contact must already exist. Bridge resolves a prospecting Agent for an eligible WhatsApp line. The template is referenced by template.id or template.name; the id wins when both are supplied. - [Request a manual handoff of a leadscout conversation to internal users](https://docs.bridge.new/api-reference/leadscout-api/request-a-manual-handoff-of-a-leadscout-conversation-to-internal-users.md): Request a manual handoff of a LeadScout-controlled conversation to one or more internal users.
- [Discover a templates agnostic variable inventory](https://docs.bridge.new/api-reference/templates-api/discover-a-templates-agnostic-variable-inventory.md): Return a template's variables — agnostic `key`/`label`/`callerMustSupply`/`isCustom`/`default`.
- [Retrieve an internal user by an identifier](https://docs.bridge.new/api-reference/internal-users-api/retrieve-an-internal-user-by-an-identifier.md): Get a specific Bridge User by any of its identifiers within the workspace.
- [Retrieve an internal user by id](https://docs.bridge.new/api-reference/internal-users-api/retrieve-an-internal-user-by-id.md): Get a specific internal user (human agent) by its unique identifier within the workspace.
- [List internal users](https://docs.bridge.new/api-reference/internal-users-api/list-internal-users.md): Retrieve a paginated list of internal users within the workspace.
- [List the agents of a workspace](https://docs.bridge.new/api-reference/agents-api/list-the-agents-of-a-workspace.md): List the workspace's Agents with their status, availability and lines.
- [Start an outbound conversation with a contact as a given agent](https://docs.bridge.new/api-reference/agents-api/start-an-outbound-conversation-with-a-contact-as-a-given-agent.md): Start an outbound conversation with a known Contact, answered by the given Agent.
- [List the pipelines of a workspace](https://docs.bridge.new/api-reference/pipelines-api/list-the-pipelines-of-a-workspace.md): List the active pipelines of the workspace, sorted by label.
- [Retrieve a pipeline with its stages and attributes](https://docs.bridge.new/api-reference/pipelines-api/retrieve-a-pipeline-with-its-stages-and-attributes.md): Get an active pipeline with its current version: stages in order, attributes and active close reasons.
- [List pipeline records](https://docs.bridge.new/api-reference/pipeline-records-api/list-pipeline-records.md): List records of the workspace, most recently updated first, found in exactly one way.
- [Create a pipeline record](https://docs.bridge.new/api-reference/pipeline-records-api/create-a-pipeline-record.md): Create a record of a contact in a pipeline, such as a sales opportunity.
- [Retrieve a pipeline record](https://docs.bridge.new/api-reference/pipeline-records-api/retrieve-a-pipeline-record.md): Get a record of the workspace by its id.
- [Update a pipeline record](https://docs.bridge.new/api-reference/pipeline-records-api/update-a-pipeline-record.md): Change the name or some values of a record, open or closed.
- [Move a pipeline record to another stage](https://docs.bridge.new/api-reference/pipeline-records-api/move-a-pipeline-record-to-another-stage.md): Move an open record to another stage of the pipeline version it follows; a final stage closes it.
- [Reopen a closed pipeline record](https://docs.bridge.new/api-reference/pipeline-records-api/reopen-a-closed-pipeline-record.md): Take a closed record back to the open stage it was in before it was closed, and clear its close reason.
- [Register a campaign lead](https://docs.bridge.new/api-reference/campaign-leads/register-a-campaign-lead.md): Registers a lead captured by a tenant's landing page and queues the first outbound WhatsApp message. A 202 means the lead was accepted, not that a message was sent.

- [Recibe eventos de forma confiable](https://docs.bridge.new/es/webhooks/receive-events.md): Verifica, guarda y confirma los webhooks; después procesa de forma segura los duplicados y los eventos fuera de orden.

- [Descubrir las variables agnósticas de una plantilla](https://docs.bridge.new/es/api-reference/templates-api/descubrir-las-variables-agn%C3%B3sticas-de-una-plantilla.md): Devuelve las variables de una plantilla: `key`/`label`/`callerMustSupply`/`isCustom`/`default`, independientes de la ubicación en Meta.
- [Obtener usuario interno por un identificador](https://docs.bridge.new/es/api-reference/internal-users-api/obtener-usuario-interno-por-un-identificador.md): Obtiene un Bridge User específico por cualquiera de sus identificadores dentro del workspace.
- [Obtener usuario interno por id](https://docs.bridge.new/es/api-reference/internal-users-api/obtener-usuario-interno-por-id.md): Obtiene un usuario interno específico (agente humano) por su identificador único dentro del workspace.
- [Listar usuarios internos](https://docs.bridge.new/es/api-reference/internal-users-api/listar-usuarios-internos.md): Consulta una lista paginada de usuarios internos del workspace.
- [Listar los agents de un workspace](https://docs.bridge.new/es/api-reference/agents-api/listar-los-agents-de-un-workspace.md): Lista los Agents del workspace con su estado, disponibilidad y líneas.
- [Iniciar conversación saliente con un contact como agent específico](https://docs.bridge.new/es/api-reference/agents-api/iniciar-conversaci%C3%B3n-saliente-con-un-contact-como-agent-espec%C3%ADfico.md): Inicia una conversación saliente con un Contact conocido, atendida por el Agent indicado.
- [Listar los pipelines de un workspace](https://docs.bridge.new/es/api-reference/pipelines-api/listar-los-pipelines-de-un-workspace.md): Lista los pipelines activos del workspace, ordenados por etiqueta.
- [Obtener un pipeline con sus etapas y atributos](https://docs.bridge.new/es/api-reference/pipelines-api/obtener-un-pipeline-con-sus-etapas-y-atributos.md): Obtiene un pipeline activo con su versión actual: etapas en orden, atributos y motivos de cierre activos.
- [Listar registros de pipeline](https://docs.bridge.new/es/api-reference/pipeline-records-api/listar-registros-de-pipeline.md): Lista los registros del workspace, del actualizado más recientemente al más antiguo, que se buscan de una sola forma.
- [Crear un registro de pipeline](https://docs.bridge.new/es/api-reference/pipeline-records-api/crear-un-registro-de-pipeline.md): Crea un registro de un contacto en un pipeline, como una oportunidad de venta.
- [Obtener un registro de pipeline](https://docs.bridge.new/es/api-reference/pipeline-records-api/obtener-un-registro-de-pipeline.md): Obtiene un registro del workspace por su id.
- [Actualizar un registro de pipeline](https://docs.bridge.new/es/api-reference/pipeline-records-api/actualizar-un-registro-de-pipeline.md): Cambia el nombre o algunos valores de un registro, abierto o cerrado.
- [Mover un registro de pipeline a otra etapa](https://docs.bridge.new/es/api-reference/pipeline-records-api/mover-un-registro-de-pipeline-a-otra-etapa.md): Mueve un registro abierto a otra etapa de la versión del pipeline que sigue; una etapa final lo cierra.
- [Reabrir un registro de pipeline cerrado](https://docs.bridge.new/es/api-reference/pipeline-records-api/reabrir-un-registro-de-pipeline-cerrado.md): Devuelve un registro cerrado a la etapa abierta en la que estaba antes de cerrarse y borra su motivo de cierre.
- [Registrar un lead de campaña](https://docs.bridge.new/es/api-reference/campaign-leads/registrar-un-lead-de-campa%C3%B1a.md): Registra un lead captado por la página de destino de un tenant y pone en cola el primer mensaje saliente de WhatsApp. Un 202 significa que el lead fue aceptado, no que se haya enviado un mensaje.

## Português do Brasil (60 pages)

- [Integre seus sistemas ao Bridge](https://docs.bridge.new/pt-br/index.md): Conecte seu CRM, automações ou landing page ao Bridge com a API REST, webhooks e Custom Connections.
- [Conecte seu assistente de programação com IA](https://docs.bridge.new/pt-br/connect-your-agent.md): Conecte Codex, Claude Code, Cursor ou GitHub Copilot à documentação atual do Bridge e implemente com base no contrato exato da API.
- [Autenticação da API REST](https://docs.bridge.new/pt-br/credentials.md): Gere e use uma chave de API no servidor para a API REST de integrações, sem confundi-la com as credenciais de webhooks e Custom Connections.
- [Glossário e identificadores](https://docs.bridge.new/pt-br/guides/identifiers.md): Encontre os identificadores corretos de workspace, Contato, usuário do Bridge, Agente, conversa, template, linha e mídia, sem confundi-los.
- [Crie um contato e envie uma mensagem](https://docs.bridge.new/pt-br/guides/first-conversation.md): Siga um fluxo completo no servidor, do Contato à conversa e à mensagem, preservando os identificadores retornados.
- [Enviar PDF e outros anexos](https://docs.bridge.new/pt-br/guides/send-attachments.md): Envie um PDF ou outro arquivo compatível em uma conversa: calcule o checksum, faça upload na URL pré-assinada e anexe o ID de mídia à mensagem.
- [Escolha e preencha um template de WhatsApp](https://docs.bridge.new/pt-br/guides/send-template.md): Descubra um template por ID ou nome, forneça os valores por suas chaves de variável agnósticas e use o ID retornado em uma requisição de conversa.
- [Inicie uma conversa outbound com um Agente](https://docs.bridge.new/pt-br/guides/agent-outbound.md): Escolha um Agente, envie um template inicial, entenda forceSend e a recuperação de conversas e solicite uma transferência LeadScout.
- [Leia todas as páginas de resultados](https://docs.bridge.new/pt-br/guides/pagination.md): Percorra os cursores opacos de Contatos, conversas, usuários do Bridge e Agentes, sem parar em uma página com poucos registros.
- [Crie e mova registros de pipeline](https://docs.bridge.new/pt-br/guides/pipeline-records.md): Crie registros de pipeline para contatos existentes, repita com segurança com Idempotency-Key, evite perder mudanças com expectedRevision e feche ou reabra registros.
- [Respostas, erros e novas tentativas](https://docs.bridge.new/pt-br/guides/responses.md): Interprete criação, aceitação, respostas vazias, erros de validação e sinais de nova tentativa, sem confundir os contratos REST e de Custom Connections.
- [Parâmetros de templates de WhatsApp](https://docs.bridge.new/pt-br/templates-and-parameters.md): Abra uma conversa com seus próprios templates de WhatsApp, preencha as variáveis e trate os erros que a requisição pode retornar.
- [Limites de requisições](https://docs.bridge.new/pt-br/rate-limits.md): Quantas requisições a API Bridge aceita, quais cabeçalhos mostram a cota disponível e como tratar corretamente uma resposta 429.
- [Códigos de erro](https://docs.bridge.new/pt-br/error-codes.md): Interprete códigos de erro da API REST, respostas de validação e resultados incertos de gravações para escolher a próxima ação.
- [Histórico de alterações](https://docs.bridge.new/pt-br/changelog.md): Mudanças da API Bridge que afetam sua integração, das mais recentes para as mais antigas.
- [Receba webhooks do Bridge](https://docs.bridge.new/pt-br/webhooks.md): Conecte um receptor HTTPS aos eventos do Bridge e entenda autenticação, confirmação de recebimento e processamento assíncrono.
- [Verifique requisições de webhook](https://docs.bridge.new/pt-br/webhooks/verifying-signatures.md): Verifique a chave de API do webhook e a representação HMAC exata usada pelo Bridge e elimine eventos aceitos repetidos.
- [Receba eventos de forma confiável](https://docs.bridge.new/pt-br/webhooks/receive-events.md): Verifique, persista e confirme webhooks; depois processe com segurança duplicatas e eventos fora de ordem.
- [Configure webhooks](https://docs.bridge.new/pt-br/webhooks/configuration.md): Configure a URL de callback, as credenciais de webhook e as assinaturas de eventos no console administrativo do Bridge.

- [Eventos de registros de pipeline](https://docs.bridge.new/pt-br/webhooks/pipeline-records.md): Eventos de webhook de registros de pipeline e ações de etapa: tipos de evento, campos do payload, triggers, motivos de fechamento e códigos de resultado das ações.

- [Listar registros de pipeline](https://docs.bridge.new/pt-br/api-reference/pipeline-records-api/listar-registros-de-pipeline.md): Lista os registros do workspace, do atualizado mais recentemente ao mais antigo, buscados de uma única forma.

- [Atualizar um registro de pipeline](https://docs.bridge.new/pt-br/api-reference/pipeline-records-api/atualizar-um-registro-de-pipeline.md): Altera o nome ou alguns valores de um registro, aberto ou fechado.
- [Mover um registro de pipeline para outra etapa](https://docs.bridge.new/pt-br/api-reference/pipeline-records-api/mover-um-registro-de-pipeline-para-outra-etapa.md): Move um registro aberto para outra etapa da versão do pipeline que ele segue; uma etapa final o fecha.
- [Reabrir um registro de pipeline fechado](https://docs.bridge.new/pt-br/api-reference/pipeline-records-api/reabrir-um-registro-de-pipeline-fechado.md): Devolve um registro fechado à etapa aberta em que estava antes de ser fechado e limpa seu motivo de fechamento.
- [Registrar um lead de campanha](https://docs.bridge.new/pt-br/api-reference/campaign-leads/registrar-um-lead-de-campanha.md): Registra um lead captado pela página de destino de um tenant e coloca na fila a primeira mensagem de saída do WhatsApp. Um 202 significa que o lead foi aceito, não que uma mensagem foi enviada.
